name: Lull
author: E. T. Carter
description: A faint static seascape — dim horizontal bands of dark water layered toward a barely-visible horizon, salted with a few sparse glints, rendered just above the threshold of visibility. Nothing within the scene moves; the entire field rides at anchor in a slow coupled sway-and-heave while a broad brightness tilt rocks across the frame in counterphase, like lamplight shifting across a deck.

params.label: Rock speed
params.effect: Rate of the whole-field rocking; even at maximum it stays slow, at minimum it is almost subliminal.

params.label: Sway amplitude
params.effect: CSS-pixel amplitude of the field's coupled horizontal sway and vertical heave.

params.label: Tilt depth
params.effect: Strength of the rocking brightness tilt across the frame, from none to a pronounced lamplight lean.
